name: Sentry Secret Serialization
description: Trace credentials leaking through serialized objects, logs, and error reports.
why: Checks both credential holders and whole-object sinks across existing code, beyond the current diff.

setup.label: Review
setup.detail: Reads source files and bundled Python and JavaScript references. No API key or scanner runtime required.

cautions: Potential credential holders and sinks are review leads until a reachable leak is established. This does not scan committed secrets or replace a general security review.

name: Sentry Skill Scanner
description: Inspect agent skills for suspicious instructions, scripts, permissions, and secret exposure.
why: Combines a bundled pattern scanner with source review before adopting unfamiliar skills.

setup.label: Runtime
setup.detail: The bundled scanner needs uv, Python 3.9+, and PyYAML. uv may download Python or dependencies on first use; the installer does not install these runtimes.

setup.label: Scanner
setup.detail: Run uv run with the absolute path to scripts/scan_skill.py inside the installed skill, followed by the target skill directory. Manual reference-based review is available if the script fails.

cautions: A clean pattern scan does not establish trust. Review script behavior and dependencies; recognized domains can still host malicious content.

name: Trail of Bits Sharp Edges
description: Review APIs and configuration for dangerous defaults and easy security mistakes.
why: Examines misuse resistance and security-sensitive design choices rather than repeating general code review.

setup.label: Review
setup.detail: Installs the core skill and language references. The optional sharp-edges-analyzer agent belongs to the upstream plugin and is not installed by this skill recipe.

cautions: Design recommendations are not permission to make breaking API changes. The upstream skill retains its Creative Commons license and attribution.
